QuestInfo.2: You told the Small Spirit what you learned from the Whispering Flowers said. It seems like he may have an idea.

0.msg: #bMy efforts to revive the Floral Flute have been unsuccessful.#k

1.msg: Hmm. I know what will help coax our flute back into tooting!\r\nI heard a whisper on the wind from a pretty pink flower.

2.msg: I know not what was said, nor who made the call. T'was important I'd wager... but I don't recall.

3.msg: #b(That... largely unhelpful soliloquy suggested one of the Whispering Flowers might know something. But there's no way of telling which one.)#k
